title: Rules.
bodyText: The attorney general may make, amend, or repeal such rules pursuant to chapter 91, as may be deemed proper to effectuate this chapter.
history: [L 1981, c 30, §4 as superseded by c 54, §4; am L 2004, c 93, §13]
bodyHtml: §467B-13  Rules.  The attorney general may make, amend, or repeal such rules pursuant to chapter 91, as may be deemed proper to effectuate this chapter. [L 1981, c 30, §4 as superseded by c 54, §4; am L 2004, c 93, §13]
